crossRefs.note: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that…
Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be…
The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, plus forty…
There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and…
To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.
This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of…

translations.web: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
translations.bsb: Be not wise in your own eyes; fear the LORD and turn away from evil.
translations.kjv: Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
translations.asv: Be not wise in thine own eyes; Fear Jehovah, and depart from evil:
